living_cost_usd_est.notes: 5-month midpoint estimate from TND 1,425-2,425/month (TND 1,925/mo) converted at Xe rate 1 TND = 0.330871 USD (collected 2026-11-15, https://www.xe.com/currencyconverter/convert/?Amount=1&From=TND&To=USD); math: 1,925 * 5 * 0.330871 = 3184.63 USD (approx. USD 3185).
